versions.changelog:
if-book-could-speak-video-generator 0.1.0

- Initial release of the "假如书籍会说话"（If Book Could Speak）video generator.
- Generates a 3-minute first-person, anthropomorphic book video from book name and author input, fully automated.
- Features AI-generated cartoon illustrations, TTS voiceover, animated subtitles, background music, and scene transitions.
- Compatible across multiple platforms (WorkBuddy, OpenClaw, Codex CLI, TRAE Work) with mapping to local or external tools for each workflow stage.
- Supports customizable TTS engines (Volcano Engine or Microsoft edge-tts) and simple resource/configuration setup.
- Outputs final MP4 video matching the visual and audio style of the original Kuzi workflow.
